evals.name: register-handler-missing-validation

assertions.text: Validates email format before touching logic or storage
Validates name is non-empty and within length bounds (1-100)
Rejects unknown fields instead of silently dropping them
Returns a 4xx status with a clear, non-leaky error message

evals.name: file-upload-path-traversal

assertions.text: Validates file size against a 5 MB limit
Validates file type by content/MIME type, not just extension
Uses an allowlist for allowed types rather than a blacklist
Returns a 4xx status with a clear error message and no internal details
